_doc: Assumed economics for healthcare_provider. Every value is 'assumed' and carries its basis.

retention_sensitivity_per_health_point.basis: assumed: multi-year provider contracts with high switching cost; a 50-point health span is taken to move 12-month retention by ~15% of ARR, i.e. 0.3% per point

revenue_at_risk_share_by_band.basis: assumed: share of the account's annual contract value expected to be lost within the horizon, by health band; long procurement cycles and compliance lock-in keep the healthy-band baseline low
